slope-intercept.alt: The line y = 12 + 3x for the cost in dollars of renting a bike for x hours, on axes from 0 to 8 hours and 0 to 40 dollars. The line starts at the intercept, 12 dollars at 0 hours. A step of 1 hour to the right (the run) goes with a rise of 3 dollars: the slope is 3 dollars per hour.
